title: Native review
subtitle: How much Arabic text is still waiting for a native Arabic reader.
waitingHint: Draft texts across templates, products, screens and system messages.
nothing: There is no Arabic text to review yet.
area.screensHint: Labels and messages shown on the Arabic screens.
area.backendHint: Replies, reminders and notices sent to customers.
rule.draft: Arabic text always starts as Draft until a native reader marks it Reviewed.
rule.machine: Text from AI or machine translation is always saved as Draft.
rule.send: An Arabic template version cannot be sent to customers until it is marked Reviewed and approved by WhatsApp.
rule.legal: Texts marked Needs legal approval (consent, opt-out, AI notice) also need your lawyer. Legal text is never machine-translated.
howTitle: How to review in a spreadsheet
step.exportBody: Ask your technical contact to export the Arabic text into spreadsheet files and send them to you. The exact commands are under "For your technical contact" below.
tech.title: For your technical contact
tech.intro: Run these in the WaFlow backend project folder. The import commands only check the file (--dry-run). Run them again without --dry-run to save the changes.
step.reviewBody: Open the file in a spreadsheet. Fix the arabic column where needed. To approve a row, set status to reviewed and write the reviewer name.
step.importBody: Send the finished files back to your technical contact. They first check them without saving anything, then save your changes.
col.key: key: the text identifier. Do not change it.
col.arabic: arabic: the Arabic text to review.
col.reviewer: reviewer: the name of the person who reviewed it (required for reviewed).
inTabsNote: Template wording and product names are reviewed inside their own tabs.
loadFailed: Could not load the review counts.
